assertion.value: This study received formal ethical approval from the relevant institutional review body at Sultan Qaboos University. Permission was granted to use anonymized student coursework for research purposes, and all data were handled in accordance with institutional policies governing confidentiality, academic integrity, research, and the protection of student information. No identifiable personal data were collected, stored, or analysed. The use of archival student writing involved no contact with participants, and all texts were anonymized prior to analysis.
